data.exact_reserve_text: The improved performance is credited to the claims ratio improving significantly. This resulted from releases in reserves from 2017, 2015 and prior years, where claims from these years have developed favourably in the year as the impact of the remediation and improvements are starting to emerge.

prior_year_events.impact_description: The change in Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to -0.75% in 2017 affected the estimate of gross and net provision for prior underwriting years.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross release of prior year reserves by GBP 115.264m in 2018, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This aligns with the narrative on page 2, which states "releases in reserves from 2017, 2015 and prior years" due to "favourably developed" claims. Key causes impacting reserves include the Ogden discount rate change in 2017 (from 2.5% to -0.75%) and ongoing claims cost inflation, particularly from imported parts and claimant behaviour.
raw_causal_phrases: releases in reserves from 2017, 2015 and prior years, where claims from these years have developed favourably
the estimate of gross and net provision was affected by the change of Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to -0.75%
Further inflation in claim severities and frequencies
depreciation of the pound affecting the prices of imported parts
Claimant behaviour could also increase claim frequencies

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This figure (-115.264m release) contradicts the 'Net claims (strengthening)/release' of +13.213m shown in Note 7, which is a net figure. The narrative on page 2 supports a release.
